site.title: Ankole
site.description: Ankole is the open source Claude Code alternative with a Company Brain. Its enterprise Agent Harness gives Agents shared context for company decisions.
hero.badge: Open source · Runs on your infrastructure · Built for enterprise use
hero.subtitle: Ankole is the open source Claude Code alternative for company work. Company Brain, live signals, enterprise authority, and results improve each decision.
hero.stack.ha: Durable Agents that survive process failure
hero.stack.memory: Company context for every authorized Agent
thread.aria: A group chat shows how Ankole captures a company rule nobody explicitly taught it and applies that rule to a later decision.
thread.h1.author: Ravi

difference.title: A model needs a system
difference.subtitle: A model supplies reasoning. The Harness controls what it sees, what it may do, how work continues, and how results inform the next decision.
difference.function.title: Current company context
difference.function.body: Ankole assembles company knowledge, live signals, participants, prior decisions, and available authority for the Agent's current decision.
difference.outcome.title: Judgment that shows its evidence
difference.outcome.body: Evidence, uncertainty, competing hypotheses, and missing information remain available for review and verification.
difference.loop.title: Work starts from live signals
difference.loop.body: Messages, schedules, webhooks, and external events wake the right Agent as the event occurs.
difference.context.title: Work continues across failures
difference.context.body: Long tasks, committed state, corrections, and delivery history survive process failure and return to the same work context.
difference.governance.title: Authority enforced by the runtime
difference.governance.body: Identity, AuthZ, approval points, audit records, and escalation paths enforce what an Agent can do. The company grants each permission.
compounding.title: Company knowledge remains after a chat
compounding.body: Ankole turns conversations, sources, corrections, and outcomes into a Company Brain. Every authorized Agent uses the same current company knowledge.
compounding.ledger.title: Company Brain · Research rules
compounding.r1.rule: Cyclicals use percentiles based on seven years of data
compounding.r1.from: Agreed in a conversation between two colleagues
compounding.r2.rule: Lead with the conclusion and include the risks
compounding.r3.rule: State when data is missing and use only observed values
compounding.r3.from: Written into the skill after an incident
compounding.r4.rule: Value the HK listing separately from the A share listing
compounding.log.p1: A vector database stores messages and retrieves fragments by similarity. It can return an old rule beside the rule that replaced it.
compounding.log.p2: Ankole records when each rule applies. It links conclusions to time, source, holder, and confidence. Repeated corrections can produce a clearer rule. Predictions stay linked to the outcomes that test them.
compounding.log.p3: The next decision uses the company's current knowledge. Each result can revise that knowledge for later work.
compounding.proof.title: Ankole tests Company Brain on its own codebase
compounding.proof.body: An Agent maintains this repository with the same Brain, tools, and work rules that Ankole gives a company. Corrections and results update the context and procedures for later maintenance.
capabilities.title: From signal to verifiable judgment
capabilities.subtitle: Ankole keeps company context current, tests assumptions, acts through connected tools, and carries results into the next decision.
capabilities.async.title: The work keeps running
capabilities.async.body: Long research, scheduled checks, and later reviews continue outside the chat. Durable state restores the same work after a process failure.
capabilities.tacit.title: Company knowledge reaches the Agent
capabilities.tacit.body: Company Brain can learn rules, preferences, rejected options, and tacit knowledge from the work where they appear.
capabilities.brain.title: Company Brain keeps company knowledge current
capabilities.brain.body: Brain keeps source, time, holder, confidence, conflict, and audience. New evidence can revise the current view without erasing how the company reached it.
capabilities.research.title: Deep Research tests competing hypotheses
capabilities.research.body: Independent evidence collection, competing hypotheses, layered review, and recorded gaps produce a cited decision brief.
capabilities.browser.title: Agent Computer executes the work
capabilities.browser.body: A browser, terminal, files, scripts, and connected tools let the Agent investigate, decide, and act.
capabilities.skills.title: Corrections update work rules
capabilities.skills.body: Repeated failures and human corrections can become bounded Skill lessons. People inspect, approve, reject, or retire each lesson.
capabilities.multi.title: Independent Agents reduce correlated errors
capabilities.multi.body: Workflow can divide one decision across isolated Agent contexts, validate structured results, and combine them. Separate contexts reduce correlated errors.
capabilities.enterprise.title: The runtime enforces authority
capabilities.enterprise.body: Enterprise identity, conditional AuthZ, approvals, audit, and channel boundaries govern every action.
usecases.title: Decisions tested by evidence
usecases.subtitle: Industry research, product selection, and deep data analysis test assumptions against evidence and observed results.
usecases.research.title: Industry research
usecases.research.deliverable: Evidence map, competing hypotheses, and a cited decision brief
usecases.research.metric: Later events test the forecast and its assumptions
usecases.selection.title: Product and market selection
usecases.selection.deliverable: Demand evidence, scenario model, and ranked choices
usecases.analysis.title: Deep data analysis
usecases.analysis.deliverable: Reproducible analysis, causal hypotheses, and decision options
usecases.analysis.metric: Observed business result and model error
usecases.quote: Fluent prose is cheap. Evidence and outcomes test every decision.
bets.title: Enterprise work survives process failure
bets.subtitle: Actor identities, isolated failure domains, live control, replaceable execution, and PostgreSQL keep work recoverable when a process crashes.
bets.actors.title: Each Session keeps its identity across process restarts
bets.actors.body: Every active Session is a Virtual Actor with an address, state, mailbox, lifecycle, and recovery position.
bets.otp.title: Failures stay local
bets.otp.body: OTP supervision trees isolate an execution branch that hangs, times out, or crashes. Ankole reconstructs that work from durable state while other work continues.
bets.fabric.title: Live control reaches running Agents
bets.fabric.body: The Rust kernel and ZeroMQ carry wakeups, steering, cancellation, checkpoints, streaming, and backpressure while the Agent is still working.
bets.computer.title: Every Agent has a work computer
bets.computer.body: Agent Computer runs the model loop, tools, browser, files, terminal, and scripts near the workspace. Ankole can rebuild Worker state. PostgreSQL keeps company facts.
bets.ledger.title: Committed work survives process failure
bets.ledger.body: PostgreSQL keeps messages, turns, reminders, decisions, delivery state, and committed actions. Streaming reports progress. The stored record identifies completed work.
quickstart.title: Run the full Harness
quickstart.subtitle: Start on one Linux, macOS, or Windows host with Docker Compose, deploy on Kubernetes, or run directly from source.
quickstart.tabs.docker: Docker Compose · Recommended for one host
quickstart.source.note: Get the toolchains ready with the installer in the repository, then start the full development environment with bun dev.
quickstart.docker.note: Run this Compose stack on Linux, macOS, or Windows wherever Docker can run Linux containers. It includes PostgreSQL, one Worker, and Caddy HTTPS.
quickstart.k8s.body: The public Helm chart deploys the verified image pair, shared Agent Home storage, and bundled or external PostgreSQL.
cta.title: Give your company a Brain
cta.body: Run Ankole on infrastructure you control. Every authorized Agent can use the same current company knowledge.
